Among them, brands like OWEN, May 10, 5S Fashion, etc., brought a range of high-end products to the program.Báo Tuổi Trẻ•14/06/2026Follow Vietnam.vn onGoogle News0 OWEN's senior director (center) participates in live stream sales for the first time - Photo: DANH KHANG After more than 10 hours, the atmosphere of the mega livestream "Supporting the Sunflower" fundraising event for the "Thuy's Dream" program, organized by Tuoi Tre newspaper and other partners, remained vibrant with famous fashion brands and great deals for shoppers. During the mega livestream, OWEN – a men's fashion brand with nearly 18 years of development in the market – offered a series of attractive deals for viewers. Many products were deeply discounted, especially short-sleeved shirts starting from only 266,000 VND, suitable for office workers and easy to wear in daily life. The comments section of the livestream was filled with surprised reactions to the brand's discounted prices. Many viewers said they rarely see OWEN offering such deep discounts, especially when shirts from the brand are available for less than 300,000 VND. In response to the viewers' enthusiasm, OWEN also gave away a T-shirt, priced at 680,000 VND, to a lucky viewer live on the livestream. This activity further enlivened the program's atmosphere with a series of interactive comments from viewers. A representative from OWEN stated that this special livestream session was not only about introducing products but also aimed at supporting child cancer patients, offering many attractive promotions to accompany the program and spread love to the community. But what surprised many was that the "model" wearing the outfit in this special live session was none other than OWEN's Senior Director, Mr. Onishi from Japan. The surprise stemmed from the fact that, during the live session, Mr. Onishi spoke Vietnamese very fluently, appearing very Vietnamese. Onishi admitted that he felt quite nervous and anxious standing on stage for the first time during a livestream session. He said that after arriving in Vietnam, what impressed him was that Vietnamese people really love livestreaming and that many of the presenters are very engaging. "This is my first time participating in a livestream session, so I feel incredibly nervous, but also very happy," he said. This is the first time the OWEN brand has participated in a livestream to introduce its products - DANH KHANG OWEN's senior director also stated that this is the brand's first time participating in a mega livestream. Normally, OWEN only distributes through its own platforms. However, this year OWEN wanted to contribute to a larger-scale event to work with other brands and businesses to strongly spread the spirit of sharing to the community. "For us, charitable and community-oriented activities are part of our annual endeavors. Participating in a large program like this allows the business to join hands with many other brands to spread positive values ​​and create a greater positive impact," he shared. When asked about his expectations for the livestream's revenue to contribute to the charity program, Mr. Onishi said that the higher the sales, the better, but more importantly, it's about being able to contribute more to community activities and support those in need. He also affirmed that OWEN is ready to continue its partnership with Tuoi Tre newspaper. Through the activities of the "Thuy's Dream" program, as well as other charitable programs in the future, we hope to contribute to spreading the spirit of compassion to society. May 10 Company participated in a mega livestream event for the first time - Photo: DANH KHANG Offering many great deals, Generos Store provides a wide range of quality men's fashion items such as t-shirts, polo shirts, and more. Mr. Nguyen Minh Hieu - Head of the livestream team for the Generos brand (May 10 Corporation) - said that Generos is a new segment of May 10 Corporation, targeting young customers. This is the first time the brand has participated in a mega livestream session.
